messages:
dmitri_cs: Heads-up: HarborOak prepping APNE2 cutover tomorrow. They asked for a short SNI-based allowlist + regional QPS bump to avoid 429s. @tara_ops can you own?

tara_ops: Yep. Need exact hostnames, target QPS, region, and duration. Also need a one-line business justification for the ticket.

dmitri_cs: Hostnames: app.harboroak-prod.com, ingest.harboroak-prod.com. Request: ap-northeast-2 from 60 -> 400 QPS for 24h. Justification: last-mile rollout and bulk ingest during migration; avoids throttling during pilot. They also want KV cache pre-warm and TLS SNI whitelist at the load-balancer.

mike_eng: We can map SNI -> allowlist entries and set auto-revoke. Staging command I used earlier: 
```bash
redwoodctl customers update --id harboroak --sni app.harboroak-prod.com,ingest.harboroak-prod.com --qps 400 --region ap-northeast-2 --revoke-in 24h
```

tara_ops: Creating change request now. @dmitri_cs paste a sanitized prod payload for the runbook.

dmitri_cs: Prod payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "customer_id":"harboroak",
  "change":{
    "region":"ap-northeast-2",
    "qps":400,
    "sni_allowlist":["app.harboroak-prod.com","ingest.harboroak-prod.com"],
    "auto_revoke":"24h"
  },
  "requested_by":"dmitri_cs"
}
```

ops-bot: ops-bot: change-request created (#CS-9001) by tara_ops - awaiting infra approval

mike_eng: Applied to staging; synthetic burst looks good. Prod window scheduled in ~12m at 02:10 UTC. Post-change watchlist: QPS, 5xx %, p99 latency, KV hit-rate. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or latency spikes > baseline + 60ms.

tara_ops: Executed prod change at 02:12 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp: 2026-03-27T02:12:00Z. CLI output saved to runbook.

dmitri_cs: Customer confirms no 429s, 5xx ~0.18%, latency within SLO. I'll run KV pre-warm for their top-20 prefixes and attach logs.

nina_ae: I'll do renewal outreach (renewal ~40 days). Will include this ramp as evidence of production readiness. DM me any extra metrics.

dmitri_cs: Action items: 1) confirm auto-revoke fires (tara_ops), 2) attach KV warmup KB + logs (dmitri_cs), 3) AE renewals outreach (nina_ae). Closing thread unless issues.
